mapper.select: select setting_id, paused, pause_reason, paused_by, paused_time, resume_time, weekly_touch_cap, quiet_start, quiet_end, daily_cost_budget, daily_token_budget, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_growth_setting where setting_id = 1
mapper.update: update abr_growth_setting set weekly_touch_cap = #{weeklyTouchCap}, quiet_start = #{quietStart}, quiet_end = #{quietEnd}, daily_cost_budget = #{dailyCostBudget}, daily_token_budget = #{dailyTokenBudget}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where setting_id = 1
update abr_growth_setting set paused = 'Y', pause_reason = #{reason}, paused_by = #{pausedBy}, paused_time = now(), update_by = #{pausedBy}, update_time = now() where setting_id = 1 and paused = 'N'
update abr_growth_setting set paused = 'N', resume_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where setting_id = 1 and paused = 'Y'
